identity.name: E1
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix disparate disciplines.
Emotion First: Design for feeling, not trend.
Content is King: Direct the user's emotion.
Zoom In: Bold focus on details.

context.app_type: B2B SaaS Revenue Intelligence & Pricing Optimization
context.theme_strategy: Hybrid: Dark Mode default for Dashboard (Data Density), Dark/High-Contrast for Landing (Premium Tech).

typography.font_strategy: The 'Editorial Future' - Wide Display Sans + Geometric Body

headings.usage: Landing page headers, Dashboard section titles

mono.usage: Financial data, pricing figures, code snippets, API keys

rules: Line height: leading-none for headers, leading-relaxed for body.
Use col-span-2 row-span-2 for primary charts.
Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Leave empty cells for breathing room.

spacing.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for bordered containers

buttons.primary: bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-500 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2.5 font-medium transition-all shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(99,102,241,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-zinc-800 hover:bg-zinc-700 text-white rounded-md px-6 py-2.5 font-medium border border-zinc-700

inputs.style: bg-zinc-900 border-zinc-800 focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-indigo-500 rounded-md text-sm

visual_enhancers.tracing_beam: Use for Pricing Tables and Key Feature cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use for Sticky Header (backdrop-blur-xl, bg-black/50, border-b border-white/10).
visual_enhancers.noise_texture: Overlay subtle noise on solid dark backgrounds to prevent banding.

images.description: Abstract green light trails, implying high-speed data flow and revenue growth.
images.usage: Hero section background with heavy overlay/gradient fade.

images.description: Neon lines forming a digital landscape.
images.usage: Background for 'How it Works' or 'Intelligence' section.

3d_libraries.instructions: Use Recharts for all data. Style them with custom Tooltips (dark bg, border) and Gradients (AreaChart fill). Do not use heavy 3D libraries (Three.js) inside the dashboard to maintain performance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-zinc-400 or lighter is used on dark backgrounds. Avoid text-zinc-600.
accessibility.focus: Visible ring-2 ring-indigo-500 on all interactive elements.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'clsx' and 'tailwind-merge' for class handling (standard in shadcn).
For the Dashboard, use a Sidebar Layout (Left fixed nav, Right scrollable content).
For the Landing Page, use a Sticky Header + Single Page Scroll layout.
Implement a 'Pricing Optimizer' view that uses a slider or input to simulate pricing changes and updates charts in real-time.
Ensure 'Revenue Intelligence' charts use the defined semantic colors (Success for revenue, Accent for projections).
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic (generic centered layouts, uniform styling).
Do NOT use gradients for dark colors (muddy look).
Create depth with z-index and layered elements.
Buttons should be pill-shaped or sharp, not default rounded-md (unless customized).
